title: Skin and body care products meeting the needs of chemotherapy patients
summary: October marks Breast Cancer Awareness Month, which raises awareness of early detection and education around the disease. But those living with cancer can also experience challenges with their skin health due to chemotherapy. Cosmetics Business rounds up the products that can support them
